snippet.title: The Archivist — Update Available Now
snippet.description:
The archive has been updated.

The first VHS tape in The Archivist’s Home has been expanded with new areas to explore, new events to uncover, and new disturbances within the house. What was once silent is no longer inactive.

This update also includes adjustments and fixes based on player feedback.

You returned to the house.
Playback has resumed.

Update Available Now.

Featuring: Let Me Call You Sweetheart by Henry Burr

Wishlist / Play The Archivist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3984300/The_Archivist/
